# emoji-picker-element-data 1.8.0

`data.json` is `en/emojibase/data.json` from the npm package [emoji-picker-element-data](https://github.com/nolanlawson/emoji-picker-element-data) 1.8.0 (Apache-2.0, `LICENSE`), unmodified. It is the picker's default English data set, previously loaded from jsDelivr.

It is built from [Emojibase](https://emojibase.dev) data (MIT, `LICENSE-emojibase`), whose emoji names and keywords come from the Unicode CLDR project (Unicode License v3, `LICENSE-unicode`). The emoji images themselves are drawn by the phone's own emoji font.
